component.title: UndoableDestructiveAction
component.purpose: Make destructive work forgiving through immediate completion and a visible recovery path.

states.description: Reversible removal is clearly explained and keyboard-operable.
The request is in flight without duplicate submission.
Failure includes a useful retry path.

claims.statement: Reversible removal exposes an explicit, time-bounded undo path.
Action controls become full-width on narrow viewports without clipping content.
